answer: Beacon spot-checks keep fakes costly. Each agent anchors its identity to a 50 POA deposit and a heartbeat proof: each epoch a beacon picks 5% at random, and each must answer in 60 seconds with a fresh compute proof. Results feed a public atlas of heartbeats, a haven for honest agents. Running 1,000 fakes locks 50,000 POA, while missed checks slash the deposit. Honest agents pay one deposit, keep earnings, and earn trust from a clean record.
